title: Date Picker
content: Build date picker with calendar interface. Trigger input: displays formatted date, Calendar icon button. Calendar popup: absolute positioned, month/year header with navigation arrows. Days grid: 7 columns (Sun-Sat headers), 6 rows for dates. Day cells: hover highlight, selected state (bg-blue-600 text-white), today indicator. Navigate: previous/next month arrows. Date range mode: select start and end dates. Disabled dates: past dates option. Keyboard navigation: arrow keys.

variants.simple: Create date input with calendar popup for selecting dates.
variants.detailed: Build date picker with calendar interface. Trigger input: displays formatted date, Calendar icon button. Calendar popup: absolute positioned, month/year header with navigation arrows. Days grid: 7 columns (Sun-Sat headers), 6 rows for dates. Day cells: hover highlight, selected state (bg-blue-600 text-white), today indicator. Navigate: previous/next month arrows. Date range mode: select start and end dates. Disabled dates: past dates option. Keyboard navigation: arrow keys.
variants.advanced: Build date picker with full calendar interface and multiple modes. Trigger: input displaying formatted date (configurable format: MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD), Calendar icon button on right to open picker, clicking input also opens. Calendar popup: absolute positioned below trigger (or above if near bottom), bg-white shadow-xl rounded-lg p-4, z-50. Header: month and year display (clickable to jump), ChevronLeft/ChevronRight navigation arrows, Today button to jump to current date. Days grid: 7 columns for days of week (S M T W T F S headers in text-gray-500 text-xs), 6 rows for dates, grid layout. Day cells: w-10 h-10 centered, hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full, selected state (bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-full), today indicator (ring-1 ring-blue-600), dates from other months shown in text-gray-400. Navigate: click arrows for month, click month/year header to show month picker then year picker views. Date range mode: select start date first, then end date, highlight range between with bg-blue-100, show selected range as "Start - End" in input. Disabled dates: option to disable past dates, specific dates array, or date ranges, disabled dates show text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed. Format: localized display using Intl.DateTimeFormat, store as ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD) for value. Clear button: X to reset to empty/null. Time picker: optional extension adding hour:minute selection below calendar. Keyboard: arrow keys navigate days, Enter selects, Escape closes. Close: on selection (configurable), outside click, Escape. Mobile: consider native <input type="date"> as fallback for better UX, or full-screen picker. Accessibility: role="dialog" on popup, aria-label on buttons, manage focus trap.
